source.name: Nasdaq press releases (primary) · Wikipedia 'List of Nasdaq-100 companies' (historical mirror)
source.note: 纳指 100 年度重组（Annual reconstitution）每年 12 月生效；其余为成分公司因股价权重不足、并购、上市地变更等触发的特别再平衡（Special rebalance）。条目按生效日排序；年度重组按字母顺序成对呈现，少数年份因 share class 拆分或前期 spinoff 导致进出数量不对称（以 — 占位）。

changes.reason: Warner Bros. Discovery 正被 Paramount Skydance 收购；Moderna 于 10 月 9 日开盘前接替其席位（10 月 1 日公告）。
changes.reasonEn: Warner Bros. Discovery, which Paramount Skydance is acquiring, leaves the index; Moderna replaces it before the open on October 9 (announced October 1).

changes.reason: Kraft Heinz 由 Nasdaq 转至 NYSE（9 月 11 日为 Nasdaq 最后交易日），自纳指 100 剔除；成分数仍不少于 100，新方法论下不替补。
changes.reasonEn: Kraft Heinz transferred its listing from Nasdaq to the NYSE (last Nasdaq trading day September 11) and left the index. With at least 100 constituents remaining, the revised methodology adds no replacement.

changes.reason: 电子艺界被沙特公共投资基金（PIF）、Silver Lake 与 Affinity Partners 组成的财团私有化收购，8 月 4 日停牌退市，自纳指 100 剔除；新方法论下不即时替补，待下一次季度审核补足。
changes.reasonEn: Electronic Arts was taken private by a consortium of Saudi Arabia's PIF, Silver Lake and Affinity Partners; its shares stopped trading on August 4 and it left the index. Under the revised methodology no replacement is added until the next quarterly review.

changes.reason: SpaceX 于 6 月 12 日 IPO，按 2026 年新增的「快速纳入」规则（排名前 40、满 15 个交易日）于 7 月 7 日开盘前加入，无剔除。
changes.reasonEn: SpaceX listed on June 12 and was added before the open on July 7 under the 2026 fast-entry rule (top-40 rank, 15 trading days). No company was removed.

changes.reason: Honeywell Aerospace 自 Honeywell 分拆并在 Nasdaq 上市，按规则自动纳入，无剔除。
changes.reasonEn: Honeywell Aerospace spun off from Honeywell, listed on Nasdaq and was automatically added; no company was removed.

changes.reason: 2026 年 6 月季度审核（新方法论下首次季度审核：按总股本市值排名，替换排名跌出前 125 的成分股）。
changes.reasonEn: June 2026 quarterly review — the first under the revised methodology (ranking by total-share market cap; companies ranked outside the top 125 replaced).
